title: Add separate Category field and filter section alongside Shape filter

requirements.text: Add a 'category' field to the Product type in backend/main.mo as a separate field distinct from the shape field, storing category as Text type
acceptanceCriteria: Product type includes a category field of type Text
Category field is independent from the shape field
Existing products can be migrated to include the category field

requirements.text: Update the createProduct backend method in backend/main.mo to accept and store the category field when creating new products
acceptanceCriteria: createProduct method accepts category parameter
Category value is stored with the product record
Category can be set independently from shape

requirements.text: Update the updateProduct backend method in backend/main.mo to support updating the category field independently from other product fields
acceptanceCriteria: updateProduct supports category field updates
Category can be updated without modifying other product fields
Category changes are persisted correctly

requirements.text: Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to include a separate category input field for each uploaded product alongside the existing shape field
acceptanceCriteria: Category input field is displayed for each product in bulk upload
Category field is independent from shape field
Auto-copy functionality includes category when enabled
Category value is sent to backend when creating products

requirements.text: Update the ProductManagementTable component (frontend/src/components/ProductManagementTable.tsx) to display the category field as a separate column and support inline editing of category independently from shape
acceptanceCriteria: Category column is displayed in the product management table
Category can be edited inline with save/cancel controls
Category dropdown or input allows selecting/entering category values
Category updates are saved to backend correctly

requirements.text: Add a separate 'Category' filter section in the Marketplace page (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) header alongside the existing 'Shape' filter section, displaying all unique category values as clickable filter tabs

quotes: 1 separate "Category" filter section alongside the existing "Shape" filter section

acceptanceCriteria: Category filter section is visually separate from Shape filter section
All unique category values from products are displayed as filter tabs
Category filter tabs are clickable and toggle selection state
Multiple category filters can be selected simultaneously
Category filters work independently from shape filters

requirements.text: Update the filter logic in Marketplace.tsx to support filtering products by both shape and category independently, where products must match selected shape filters AND selected category filters

quotes: 1 separate "Category" filter section alongside the existing "Shape" filter section

acceptanceCriteria: Products are filtered by both shape and category selections
If no shape filters are selected, all shapes are shown (filtered only by category)
If no category filters are selected, all categories are shown (filtered only by shape)
If both filters are selected, products must match both criteria
Filtered results update all product sections (featured, most viewed, best selling, newest)

requirements.text: Update the ProductCard component (frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx) to display both shape and category information on each product card
acceptanceCriteria: Both shape and category are displayed on product cards
Shape and category are visually distinguishable from each other
Layout accommodates both fields without cluttering the card design

requirements.text: Update the ProductDetailView component (frontend/src/components/ProductDetailView.tsx) to display both shape and category fields in the product detail modal
acceptanceCriteria: Shape is displayed in product detail view
Category is displayed in product detail view as a separate field
Both fields are clearly labeled and distinguishable

requirements.text: Update all React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to handle the new category field in product data structures for fetching and mutating products
acceptanceCriteria: useProducts hook returns products with category field
useCreateProduct mutation includes category parameter
useUpdateProduct mutation supports category updates
TypeScript types are updated to include category field

constraints: Maintain single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo

Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Keep shape and category as completely independent fields that can be set and filtered separately
Ensure backward compatibility with existing products that may not have category values
nonGoals: Combining shape and category into a single field
Removing the existing shape filter functionality
Creating predefined category lists or validation (allow free text entry)
